aiGuidance.purpose: Page, chapter, section, paragraph or timestamp — enough for a reader to turn to it. Give it only at the level actually checked and do not invent page, chapter or paragraph numbers; 'ch. 2' from a reflowable ebook with no page anchors is honest, an invented 'p. 47' is not. Where an edition matters to the number, name the edition here too.

description: Where in the source the passage is found.
name: locator
